items.briefing:
Asia Pacific leaders are calling for stronger defences against scams, a timely reminder for Australian staff to stay alert to suspicious calls, texts, and emails. Separately, security researchers are warning that AI tools can create new vulnerabilities when they are set up incorrectly — something worth keeping in mind as our organisation explores AI technologies.

On the global threat front, cybercriminals are continuing to evolve their tactics, with malware campaigns resurfacing across multiple regions. While these are not directly targeting Australia right now, the methods used often spread quickly.

**Tip:** If you receive an unexpected message asking you to click a link or share information, verify it through a separate, trusted channel before responding.

featured.title: Google adds Antigravity to Gemini Enterprise subscriptions
featured.summary: Enterprises can now give developers the coding agent via Google Cloud controls, with pooled budgets, audit logs and IDE support included.
